title: Director, Martech and Applied AI, YouTube Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. This means you work with a cross-functional team across Sales, corporate communications, legal, webmasters, product development, engineering and more. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.

YouTube is seeking a MarTech Leader to define and execute a technology vision at the intersection of Marketing, Product, and Engineering. You will own the end-to-end roadmap and architecture of the YouTube Marketing Technology stack, transforming ambitious marketing goals into rigorous technical specifications.

As a primary bridge between functions, you will advocate for an AI-powered infrastructure that scales globally. We are looking for a visionary who commands the respect of engineering and the trust of marketing, ensuring our data and operations aren't just efficient, but are key drivers of YouTube’s growth.

This role reports to the Sr. Director of YouTube Marketing Strategy, Insights, and Analytics, leading a team of ~20 reports.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the MarTech roadmap, transforming isolated marketing requests into an interoperable technology portfolio.
  • Drive efficiency improvements by automating key marketing surfaces and scaling our ability to deliver personalized communications to billions of users. Forge deep, high-trust relationships with product management and engineering.  
  • Drive principled architectural decisions, determining when to leverage YouTube/Google’s internal engineering stack (data gravity, scale) versus integrating external solutions (speed, agility). Oversee end-to-end architecture of our core platforms.
  • Lead the technical design for marketing data pipelines, ensuring strict adherence to privacy (GDPR/CCPA) while maximizing signal fidelity for attribution and measurement. 
  • Develop and advocate for a shared long-term vision for how AI/ML will transform YouTube's marketing efforts. Advocate for a culture of automation.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience in a technical field.
  • 15 years of experience in Marketing Technology, Product Management, or Engineering Leadership, with 5 years specifically managing technical roadmaps.
  • 8 years of experience as a people manager leading teams.
  • Experience designing systems for two-sided marketplaces or platforms (e.g., balancing supply/creators and demand/viewers).
  • Experience querying and architecting data environments.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or MBA with a technical focus.
  • Experience building proprietary internal marketing tools or platforms, rather than solely integrating off-the-shelf vendors.
  • Experience as a software engineer or data engineer prior to moving into leadership/strategy.
  • Understanding of streaming video delivery, algorithmic recommendation systems, and how off-platform marketing signals influence on-platform engagement.

title: Data Center Technician II
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Belgium: €68000 - €69500 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Unpack, rack, wire, and bring new physical hardware, servers, and network equipment online.
  • Diagnose hardware issues as they happen by following clear procedures to figure out what’s broken and get the equipment back up and running.
  • Safely manage sensitive storage hardware; track, securely erase, old hardware in accordance with security standards to ensure data is not at risk.
  • Dismantle outdated equipment that has reached the end of its life, salvaging usable components and recycling the rest.
  • Perform routine checks and physical maintenance on servers, networking equipment, and infrastructure to prevent problems before they start.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware.
  • Experience with the assembly of mechanical or electrical systems, or performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
  • Experience with networking protocols.
  • Ability to lift /move up to 23kg of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
  • Must have the ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems.
  • Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.
  • Experience with Linux operating systems.

title: Marketing Category Strategist, Media and Sponsorships
descriptionHtml:
In the Google Procurement Organization (GPO), our aim is to unlock value for Google to reinvest in what matters most. We do this by bringing velocity, efficiency, and security to buying at Google, while partnering deeply across Google to deliver solutions fit for purpose. As a centralized organization operating in a high complexity environment, we bring "one voice" to stakeholders and suppliers to ensure the best outcomes. Our organization fosters a culture of collaboration and innovation while providing opportunities for ongoing career growth and development.

As a part of our Marketing Category Management team this role will focus primarily on creating global category strategies for Google’s various Media and Sponsorship opportunities. You will seamlessly align regional execution with global procurement initiatives while channeling local insights to inform overarching category strategies. By driving proactive category governance, you will develop innovative category strategies and cultivate strategic relationships that unlock measurable enterprise value. You will maintain a holistic view of the Google marketing ecosystem through a Media and Sponsorship lens, ensuring procurement decisions complement broader business partnerships. Leveraging your expertise in marketing verticals, you will navigate cross-functional networks and partner closely with marketing teams to address evolving business needs. Crucially, you will advocate an AI-first approach across your domain. By guiding new AI approaches and piloting emerging tools, you will maintain domain thought leadership on the impact to our supplier base and ensure sound category governance, utilizing strong data and financial acumen to streamline workflows, mitigate risk, and evolve commercial frameworks to drive a competitive advantage for Google.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $136000 - $196000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a strategic commercial partner for media and sponsorships across Marketing, Finance, and non-Marketing Product Areas to influence agreement forums and maximize spend under management.
  • Operationalize valuation frameworks to evaluate sponsorship agreements and deliver financial insights (e.g., Profit & Loss (P&L), Return on Investment (ROI), and Fair Market Value (FMV)) to executive leadership.
  • Develop and execute multi-year category plans for global and regional sponsorship spend areas to achieve annualized category savings and expand spend under management.
  • Execute end-to-end sourcing initiatives, Request For (X) RFx processes, and complex agreement negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms and mitigate operational risk.
  • Adopt emerging AI tools and digital workflows to automate spend analysis, evaluate sponsor capabilities, and optimize supplier tracking.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Finance, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7 years of experience in sales strategy, sourcing, category management, or procurement roles supporting marketing, media, sponsorships or related categories.
  • Experience executing sourcing strategies, RFx processes, negotiations, and supplier evaluations, agreement drafting, review, and management.
  • Experience in stakeholder management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or certification in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • Experience analyzing procurement data, generating reports, and providing insights to support decision-making.
  • Experience developing and managing key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure category performance.
  • Experience leading strategic projects aimed at improving procurement or sales processes and implementing new strategies.
  • Experience leveraging technology and investigative tools to enhance category management practices.

title: Speechwriter, Executive Communications
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Communications & Public Affairs team, you will work cross-functionally to help communicate with journalists and other thought leaders; devise specific communications materials and campaigns; engage in face-to-face meetings with commentators and other opinion formers; and develop print and web-based material supporting these campaigns. We're looking for great communicators who can understand complex issues and explain them in person and also via well written, simple blog posts, FAQs, video scripts and more.

As a member of our Central Communications team, you will be a part of the team responsible for Google’s most executive leaders and telling the stories of our products, strategy, and culture. You will lead on preparing speeches, op-eds, blog posts, video scripts and more around complex issues and technical breakthroughs. And you will be part of the creative engine that goes beyond traditional comms approaches to build trust with audiences, including policymakers, creators, journalists, and other key opinion formers.

It's our job to help inform and educate users, advertisers, partners, opinion leaders--and our own employees--about the benefits of Google's products, our distinctive company culture/values, and our approach to the big public policy issues of the day. To succeed here, you'll combine creativity with organizational skills to manage multiple projects with tight deadlines simultaneously, as well as enjoy pitching to journalists, bloggers and commentators, or producing internal communications and events for our employees. Things happen quickly at Google and to get stuff done here you need to be an enthusiastic team player who can work cross-functionally and isn't hesitant to take risks or try new things.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $171000 - $247000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead speechwriting and editorial for exceutive leaders across channels (including but not limited to blogs, op-eds, video scripts, internal communications).
  • Work cross functionally with teams across global communications, marketing, product, and policy to produce high quality, high volume content for external and internal audiences.
  • Maintain editorial calendar, keeping up to date with the latest company and product announcements and creating data-driven strategies to inject executive voice.
  • Develop and pitch creative ideas for editorial and content, going beyond traditional channels and staying up-to-date with industry trends and best practices.
  • Pitch in on content development for social media, briefings, talking point, company narratives and special projects as needed.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 year of experience in public relations, media relations, or internal and executive communications with technology products or services.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in speechwriting, executive communications strategy, and developing a brand voice.
  • Ability to work calmly and maintain good judgment in fast-paced, high-stress environments.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Group Product Manager, Android and Wear Health Services
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

As a Group Product Manager, you will define and execute the core health, fitness, and continuous sensing strategy for Google’s wearable platform. You will lead the platformization of health APIs, sensor ingestion, exercise tracking infrastructure, and cross-device fitness continuity across Pixel Watch, Fitbit, third-party OEMs and emergent multi-device ecosystems (such as Android XR). You will serve as an Individual Contributor responsible for high-stakes platform architectures, complex partner relationships, and technical product definitions that power health features for millions of wrist-wearable users worldwide.

Platform teams push the boundaries of embedded systems, sensing accuracy, and low-power compute. You will bridge hardware constraints with high-level software abstractions, ensuring that our wearable ecosystem delivers exceptional health accuracy, low-power continuous tracking, and developer-friendly platform APIs.

Are you ready to shape the future of wearable technology and impact how millions of people experience wearables daily? Are you ready to empower developers building the apps that define this rapidly evolving device category? Help us with one of the most important challenges: designing for the most personal devices worn today by millions of users. The Wear OS team's mission is to effortlessly connect users with their health, loved ones, and the world around them, offering a seamless smartwatch experience with access to their favorite apps and services. We provide the core Android experience, tailored specifically for wearables. The age of wearable computing is upon us and Wear OS is at the forefront of creating a place for users, hardware manufacturers, and app developers to come together and help make lives simpler and more seamless.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Own the multi-year Android Health Services & Wear Health Services (AHS/WHS) direction across first-party (Pixel Watch, Fitbit) and third-party (3P) Android ecosystems.
  • Lead end-to-end definition for health data types, granular permissions (e.g., Raw Health Sensors), and low-power exercise session tracking.
  • Partner on Hardware/Software (HW/SW) offloading—including continuous sensing, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE GATT) ingestion (power, HR, cadence), and Microcontroller Unit (MCU) display offload—to optimize battery life.
  • Collaborate with Gemini and XR teams on Universal Fitness Objects (UFO), AI coaching, and streaming to Augmented Reality (AR) glasses.
  • Direct strategic OEM partnerships, Early Access Programs, and developer outreach. Oversee accuracy benchmarking (Sense8) and privacy/security reviews with PCounsel and PWG.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Bioengineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience leading complex technical partnerships across Tier-1 OEMs, silicon vendors, and third-party developers (e.g., Strava).
  • Experience in low-power HW/SW co-design (MCU offloading, BLE GATT ingestion) and cross-device experience definition (watches, phones, AR/XR).
  • Knowledge in PPG algorithms, GNSS, HR, SpO2, HRV, and vitals monitoring.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Legal, and Privacy along with excellent storytelling skills.

title: Research Scientist, Gemini Commercial Intelligence, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Join a collaborative and vibrant team of experts in LLMs, multimodal generation/understanding, ML efficiency, and RecSys. We focus on: 1. benchmarking and improving Gemini models across modalities to advance users' commercial journey; 2. self-improving agents to power ML modeling and innovative GenAI experiences across Gemini, Ads, Commerce, and Google. In this role, you will be driving research innovations, rapid-prototyping concepts, curating benchmarks, designing experiments, and bridging the path from research to fruition.


Some of our current projects focus on these areas:
  • Natural Language & Multimodal Understanding/Generation
  • Planning and reasoning
  • Reinforcement Learning
  • Agents

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.


We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Work with experts on LLMs, multi-modal, recommendation systems, personalization, and ML efficiency. 
  • Drive new research ideas from conception, experimentation, to production in a rapidly shifting landscape.
  • Drive project work by defining the data structure, framework, design, and evaluation metrics for research solution development and implementation. Identify timelines and obtain resources needed.
  • Identify new and upcoming research areas by interacting with potential external and internal collaborators. Help in developing long-term research strategy and plans to expand the impact of Google research.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience building and shipping technical products.
  • 2 years of experience leading a research agenda.
  • Experience in the domain area of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLM).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 3 years of research experience (e.g., model training/deployment, efficiency optimization, data pipeline design, ML infra).
  • 2 years of experience leading research efforts and influencing other researchers.
  • One or more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories.

title: Technical Solutions Engineer Manager, Infrastructure, Compute, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

Our Technical Solutions Engineers manage customer challenges in addition to providing level two support to our other Support teams. In this role, you will be a part of a global team that provides support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud. In this role, you will troubleshoot technical challenges for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, documentation updating, and coding/scripting. You will make our products easier to adopt and to use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes, and documentation. You'll help drive business growth of Google Cloud by recognizing and advocating for our customers’ challenges.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $176000 - $256000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of individuals; set and communicate individual and team priorities that support organizational goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development, and provide feedback and coaching.
  • File issue reports against product, documentation and procedures by documenting desired behavior and/or steps to reproduce, and driving bugs to resolution.
  • Suggest code-level resolutions for complex product bugs by leveraging relevant tools and effective communication to all stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Resolve technical incidents and escalations by performing analysis utilizing relevant tools (e.g., SQL, R, Python) and leveraging custom data infrastructure or existing data models as appropriate, and formulating and interpreting data to reach specific conclusions and next steps.
  • Identify opportunities and build solutions to improve support or empower customers to solve issues by using self-service tools and documentation.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 13 years of experience troubleshooting and advocating for customers' needs, and triaging technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, application, operational, process).
  • 3 years of experience managing a technical, customer-facing team.
  • Experience with 2 or more of the following: Web Tech, Data/Big Data, Systems Admin, Machine Learning, Networking, Kubernetes, Oracle, or SAP.
  • Experience reading code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, C, C++, Python, Shell, Go, JavaScript) or in system design.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with Cloud Accelerators troubleshooting (GPU, TPU, etc.).
  • Experience in troubleshooting and supporting large-scale applications such as web services, data storage, databases, data pipelines, high-performance computing, commerce engines, with Linux/Unix or operating systems.
  • Experience managing Enterprise customer relationships and advocating for issues or needs.
  • Experience with managing hosted services/SaaS including familiarity with one or more of the following programming/scripting languages: Java, C, C++, .NET, Go, Python, shell, Perl, JavaScript.
  • Ability to operate in a customer focused environment and advocate for customers across a cross-functional organization.
  • Excellent judgment, strategic thinking, and creative problem-solving skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Workspace (multiple openings)
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Google's software developers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for software developers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software developer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our software developers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $174,000 - $253,000 + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Learn more about benefits at Google.

Position reports to the Google office & may allow for a hybrid schedule as per Google policy.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
  • Manage project priorities, deadlines and deliverables.
  • Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
  • Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
  • Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback; and Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, or a related field and 5 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate experience in the job offered or in a Software Engineer-related occupation.
  • Position requires the following: 5 years of experience in Software development utilizing C++, Kotlin, Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript; 5 years of experience in Data structures, Algorithms, and Debugging and testing; 5 years of experience in one of the following: Web application development, Mobile app development, Backend infrastructure systems, Distributed systems, or Building applications for a browser; 2 years of experience in System Design; and 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role, including leading projects, serving as a subject matter expert, or working cross-functionally with other teams.

title: App Measurement Specialist, Large Customer Sales (English, Turkish)
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As an App Measurement Specialist in Large Customer Sales, you will be the authority on app attribution, analytics, and signal durability across Google's full-funnel advertising portfolio. You will care deeply about connecting digital media investments to downstream in-app value, bridging the gap between Google's advertising platforms, third-party Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs like AppsFlyer and Adjust), and client-side data systems.

You will act as a trusted advisor to decision-makers and C-level leads at an enterprise account across Turkey. You will help them navigate through shifts in mobile privacy and guide the architectural adoption of durable measurement solutions. By demystifying attribution models, resolving Source of Truth discrepancies, and unlocking cross-channel in-app value, you will translate complex measurement clarity into commercial confidence and accelerated business growth.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and execute sales/product strategies within functions to specific clients to meet desired outcomes, align product and business strategies to develop a roadmap, and provide feedback to inform and align product and go-to Market (GTM) strategies.
  • Identify business growth opportunities within the market and for customers and work with internal stakeholders to determine and drive the business growth, potential of opportunities, and marketing efficiency, and the incremental investment recommended to achieve customer business outcomes.
  • Manage expectations and maintain relationships with stakeholders to build rapport and credibility, and plan, create, deliver strategy, and provide input to help stakeholders achieve project goals.
  • Share and scale best practices, learnings, and business strategies (e.g., objection managing, pitching, business techniques, etc.) to upscale accounts, and link solutions and best practices to meet customer and Google business needs.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in digital media, sales, marketing, or product roles.
  • Experience working with digital organizations.
  • Experience identifying and recommending solutions to improve customer strategy, and working with executive leadership.
  • Experience in the app and mobile marketing ecosystem, including third-party attribution partners (MMPs), Self-Attributing Networks (SANs), mobile ad networks, and native app store ecosystems (e.g., Google Play).
  • Ability to communicate in English and Turkish fluently to engage with global internal teams and external clients.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Extensive knowledge of Mobile Measurement Partners (e.g., AppsFlyer, Adjust), including postback setup, attribution waterfall rules, and raw log analysis.
  • Expertise in privacy-safe measurement protocols, including cross-industry frameworks (e.g., SKAN, Privacy Sandbox) and Google's dedicated solutions (e.g., Firebase, On-Device Measurement - ODM, and Integrated Conversion Measurement - ICM).
  • Deep understanding of the App-first industries, a goal for its growth, and a commitment to advance Google's forward-looking strategies within the above vertical.
  • Deep knowledge of conversion tracking setup and management within Google platforms.
  • Deep knowledge of Web-to-App measurement frameworks and deep linking infrastructure.

title: Data Center Power Infrastructure Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Finland: €98000 - €100000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits
Netherlands: €130000 - €133000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits
Sweden: kr1000000 - kr1020000 (SEK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data center power infrastructure across EMEA markets from origination and negotiation through execution and post-energization management, encompassing transmission and distribution grid connections, virtual power plants, and direct-wire structures.
  • Secure adequate, reliable power to support planned data center development and growth.
  • Partner with transmission system operators, distribution system operators, and internal teams (policy, commercial negotiation, acquisition, leasing, technical engineering) to optimize schedules, capacity, cost efficiency, and risk mitigations.
  • Develop business cases for power acceleration and capacity expansion via flexible interconnections, on-/off-site generation, transmission buildouts, and novel large-load solutions.
  • Track project variances, maintain accurate planning data, manage counterparties for on-time delivery, and conduct energy due diligence during site selection to drive portfolio expansion.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Release Engineering, Google Cloud Platforms

title: Forward Deployed Engineer III, Data Cloud, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on the Data Cloud team, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier data solutions and production-grade reality for customers. You will function as an "innovator-builder," working directly within customers’ environments to move data and machine learning workloads from idea to production on Google Cloud, leveraging experience with programming languages (e.g. PySpark, SQL, Python) and the data cloud ecosystem (e.g. BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB). You will build the data foundations that agents depend on, and train and evaluate machine learning models on customer data. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Build and ship production data and machine learning workloads with customers, writing, testing, and performance-tuning PySpark, SQL and Python on BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner and AlloyDB.
  • Present working proofs with customers’ data, including de-identifying sensitive data (e.g., PCI, PHI).
  • Build the data foundation for agentic solutions, including lakehouse architectures, metadata, semantic context, and the access controls that let custom agents act on trusted data.
  • Train, evaluate and deploy machine learning and agentic components where they improve the customer’s business metric, with evaluation and monitoring in place.
  • Refactor and migrate high-cost analytics, Spark and operational database workloads from other platforms onto Google Cloud engines, with measured price-performance results.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, machine learning, or technical consulting, including coding experience in Python and SQL.
  • Experience with data cloud ecosystem products, technologies, or languages (e.g., Apache Spark, PySpark, BigQuery, Spanner, Data Catalog, and AlloyDB).
  • Experience taking production-grade data cloud solutions from conception to launch, including architecting data systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP) and building structured/unstructured pipelines.
  • Experience training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in production.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
  • Experience in prompt developing, model evaluation, and the creative application of AI.

You will lead complex, ambiguous investigations into high-severity threat actors and abuse vectors, driving cases from initial discovery and root-cause analysis through network-scoped disruptions and cross-Product Area (xPA) enforcement mitigations. You will combine investigative tradecraft with coding and analytical execution, leveraging SQL, Python, large-scale data analysis, and AI/agentic workflows to prototype automation, build data pipelines, and operationalize threat signals with engineering partners. You will bridge qualitative threat intelligence with quantitative systems analysis by evaluating detection performance (e.g., precision, recall), contributing to reusable investigative playbooks, and mentoring junior analysts.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Staff ML Compiler Engineer, TPU Performance Optimizations
descriptionHtml:

You will design and implement advanced compiler optimizations such as pipelining, prefetching, and fusions to maximize TPU efficiency. You will collaborate across teams to integrate frameworks like PyTorch and ensure the hardware remains the industry’s premier Machine Learning (ML) platform.The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. Preferred qualifications:

title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Center Network Switches
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Work on the latest AI/ML networks for TPUs and GPUs.
  • Work with hardware and software systems, programming the data plane and control plane for networking applications which drive the world's largest network infrastructure.
  • Manage individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.
  • Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance and enhancement of software solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience programming in C++.
  • 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
  • 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Experience with network architecture, ethernet switching, software development and network infrastructure.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.
  • Good understanding of modern AI/ML infrastructure, ideally including network architecture.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Discover Feed Recommendations
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Discover is Google’s personalized interest feed, connecting users globally with the best content from across the web in real time.

Every Discover feed starts with Discover User Modeling and Retrieval. Because core retrieval and ranking rely heavily on historical engagement, newly ingested documents remain unindexed and expire before reaching the signal thresholds needed to show their quality. We built Discover’s end-to-end content exploration system to break this bottleneck, spanning real-time multi-tier lifecycle control and embedding-based cold-start retrieval.

Join Google Search AI and work at the intersection of industry leading
global scale. We apply breakthrough research, leveraging models like Gemini, to launch high-impact products that help billions ask any question and get things done. If you want to drive the future of AI in Search and work with world-class experts to deliver tangible, global impact and continuous innovation, this is the place.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Research and deploy ML models that identify content by combining multimodal LLM understanding, uncertainty estimation, and causal modeling to maximize exploration ROI at scale.
  • Drive projects from problem formulation and experimentation design through model training, real-time serving architecture, and production launches, collaborating closely with Feed Ranking, Content, and Infra teams.
  • Partner to align semantic applicant retrieval, ranking incentives, and warm-start handoffs so promising new content seamlessly activates the organic recommendation flywheel.
  • Lead zero-history discovery for Discover’s top formats—making dynamically generated AI content (AIGC) a citizen across the stack and surfacing breaking news within minutes of publication.
  • Evolve StarSearch into the intelligent gatekeeper for Discover’s content ecosystem—safely bootstrapping fresh, niche, and creator supply to expand personalization headroom while rapidly pruning unengaged content to keep the serving corpus fresh and efficient.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
  • 3 years of experience with end-to-end Machine Learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).
  • 3 years of experience building and deploying recommendation systems models (retrieval, prediction, ranking, personalization, search quality, embedding) in production; and experience building architecture.
  • Experience developing personalization algorithms for user-specific content delivery.
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or related technical field.
  • 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • Experience in Content Exploration/Exploitation (e.g., Bandit systems, Reinforcement Learning) or solving Cold Start problems.
  • Experience with feed recommendation systems or budgeting systems.
  • Experience with data pipelines and system design for real-time evaluation.

title: Data Center Site Manager
descriptionHtml:

title: Optical Transport Senior Network Implementation Engineer (English)
descriptionHtml:
As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.

The NASA WAN Capacity Infrastructure team leads the system-level design and end-to-end deployment of the fiber optic transport network connecting Google's data centers worldwide. This infrastructure enables Google to operate as a unified global computing system and maintains continuous, high-capacity data transport across all regions.

In this role, your responsibilities span the network lifecycle—from installation and commissioning to troubleshooting and decommissioning—using site surveys and audits to ensure strict specification compliance. Utilizing your experience in networking, data centers, and co-location, you will refine best practices to build a reliable, cost-effective, and scalable network supporting Google's global users.

Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.

descriptionHtml:
Technical Infrastructure (TI) is the backbone of Google - the global data centers, networks and integrated hardware and software that power both Google customer products and services, including Google Cloud, and our internal operations. Google builds and operates one of the largest state-of-the-art private data center fleets in the world. It is a complex technical area with very large operating and capital budgets growing year over year.

The TI Finance mission is to partner cross-functionally to drive optimal decision-making, provide insights for strategic and tactical decisions, and bend the cost curve down to provide Google with a competitive advantage.

In this position, you will lead the finance team partnering with Data Center Construction, responsible for the end-to-end capital deployment and delivery of Google's global data center builds (civil, structural, architectural, electrical, and mechanical integration). You will play a key role in shaping commercial contracting strategies, optimizing multi-billion-dollar project budgets, and ensuring financial discipline as Google expands its infrastructure footprint.

As a Senior Finance Manager for Data Center Construction, you will move beyond traditional cost accounting to act as the primary strategic business partner for Alphabet’s multi-billion-dollar data center construction portfolio. Leading the team dedicated to global capacity delivery, you will direct financial governance over multi-billion dollar capital deployment, and evaluate commercial construction strategy to optimize return on investment.

This role demands a blend of large-scale infrastructure capital management, construction commercial acumen, and executive-level leadership. You will advocate financial governance across project life-cycles, guide cash flow optimization for long-cycle build schedules, and deliver executive-level insights to TI leadership.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $219000 - $305000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the lead finance partner and primary liaison between Data Center Construction, Real Estate/Site Selection, Supply Chain, and Capacity Planning.
  • Lead and mentor a high-performing team of finance professionals (including direct management and coaching of construction Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) analysts and managers).
  • Partner with Construction and Engineering leadership to establish rigorous capital expenditure governance, tracking budgets, commitments, contingencies, and cash-flow milestones for active and planned builds.
  • Drive financial evaluation and risk analysis for general contracting strategies, commercial delivery models (e.g., Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC), Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP), Design-Build, Build-to-Suit (BTS)), and change order governance.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to optimize unit costs (e.g., $/MW) and implement benchmarking frameworks across global project sites.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Construction Management, Statistics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 14 years of experience in business partnering, investment banking, consulting, or a related function, or an advanced degree.
  • 5 years of experience in infrastructure, data center, or commercial construction finance.
  • Experience building, developing, and leading a team.
  • Experience managing multi-billion-dollar capital expenditures within a technology or industrial environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • MBA, Master's or advanced degree in Finance, Construction Management, or Engineering.
  • Experience in commercial construction contracting methodologies (GMP, Cost-Plus, Lump Sum, Target Cost) and project controls.
  • Experience developing long-range cash flow and capital forecasting tooling for large, multi-year mega-projects.
  • Experience in Board-level and executive communications, with a strong executive presence.
  • Ability to partner with and influence engineering, construction, and corporate development executives.

title: Senior Power Management Engineer, Platforms Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Our computational issues are so big, complex and unique we can't just purchase off-the-shelf hardware, we've got to make it ourselves. Our Platforms Team designs and builds the hardware, software and networking technologies that power all of Google's services.

In this role, you will design and build the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. You will develop from the lowest levels of circuit design to large system design and see those systems all the way through to high volume manufacturing. Your work will have the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our data centers affecting millions of Google users. As a key member of the team, you will manage projects in multiple areas with your expertise.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Define, design, and implement power management solutions for Google’s data center hardware spanning ML TPU, GPU, Networking, Server compute, Storage, and any additional computing hardware and supporting solutions for data centers.
  • Perform power management design validation and root-cause analyses. Lead the triage and resolution of power management issues.
  • Develop methodologies for system power modeling and validation of power management features.
  • Engage suppliers and ecosystem partners to develop high-quality power management solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience working in a hardware design, bring-up, and debugging technical environment, or 3 years of experience with an advanced degree.
  • Experience with power modeling, power architecture, or power management techniques.
  • Experience in power management techniques at both chip and system levels (including voltage frequency scaling, power states, and thermal management).
  • Experience in inter-chip power management interface (e.g., SPMI, AVSBus, and PMBus).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
  • 1 year of experience in technical leadership.
  • Experience in defining and implementing power management architectures and designs.
  • Experience with real-time control systems.
  • Knowledge of power electronics fundamentals and various power conversion technologies for data center power delivery.
  • Knowledge of power converter modeling and simulation and understanding of computer and system architectures.

title: Manager, Data Center Server Operations
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As a Hardware Operations Manager, you will manage a team of Data Center Technicians. You will oversee the quality installation of server hardware and components and take charge of complicated installations/troubleshooting.

Your team will install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). They will also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. They may lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

title: Senior UX Designer, Chrome Search
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Interaction Designers transform complex tasks into intuitive, easy-to-use experiences for billions of people. From creating user flows and wireframes to building mockups and prototypes, you will envision and bring product experiences to life with an inspired, refined, and magical feel. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, leveraging user insights to create industry-leading products.

As an Interaction Designer, you'll apply user-centered design methods to craft industry-leading user experiences from concept to execution, working with design partners to evolve the Google design language to build beautiful, innovative products.

The Chrome Search UX team shapes how billions of users express intent, attach context, and take action across the web. Working at the intersection of Chrome, Google Search, and Google AI, you will craft the next generation of browser-native search experiences—spanning multimodal inputs (text, voice, and visual), contextual browsing assistance, and AI-powered agentic workflows.

In this high-visibility role, you will balance bold 0-to-1 exploration with Chrome's foundational principles of speed, simplicity, security, and user trust. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams across mobile and desktop platforms to evolve iconic, high-frequency browser surfaces and define how AI transforms everyday browsing at global scale.

Chrome is dedicated to building a better, more open web. We’re focused on making a better browser (on both desktop and mobile) to help users take advantage of all the web has to offer in a safe and secure way.Chrome is available across all major platforms — iOS, Android, Windows, Mac, Linux and Chrome OS. We also built Chrome as an open source project so the entire web ecosystem could benefit from the latest innovations in speed, simplicity and security.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end interaction and visual design for AI-powered Chrome Search experiences, spanning multimodal inputs, contextual assistance, and agentic workflows.
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Research, Data Science, Privacy, and Legal to turn complex constraints into intuitive, user-centered solutions.
  • Prototype 0-to-1 concepts and micro-interactions using modern design, motion, and AI-assisted workflows to deliver clear flows and specs.
  • Structure and iterate on live experiments, combining behavioral data and research insights to balance innovation with speed and simplicity.
  • Evolve scalable UI patterns across mobile and desktop, and present design rationale and product goal to senior leadership.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of interaction design experience in product design or UX design.
  • Experience in visual design and interaction design for consumer-facing web or mobile products.
  • Experience designing AI-powered products or using AI tools in design workflows.
  • Include a portfolio, website, or any other relevant link to your work in your resume (providing a viewable link or access instructions).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization.
  • 2 years of experience leading design projects.
  • Experience with motion design, interactive prototyping, and design systems across mobile and desktop platforms.
  • Experience designing multimodal or agentic AI interfaces, running A/B experiments, and presenting design strategy to executive stakeholders.

title: Technical Program Manager, Energy Risk
descriptionHtml:

As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. Responsibilities

  • Establish, manage, and refine frameworks to measure and mitigate complex risk exposures (e.g., price, shape and counterparty risks) across Google’s global, multi-gigawatt energy portfolio.
  • Translate risk analytics, quantitative metrics, and wholesale power market dynamics into actionable insights that shape Google's long-term energy strategy and infrastructure footprint.
  • Lead high-impact technical programs bridging Energy Origination, Procurement, Operations, Finance, and Data Science to embed robust risk frameworks into portfolio decision-making.
  • Provide strategic guidance to commercial transaction teams on optimal risk allocation, hedging, and mitigation strategies to ensure complex agreements fall within acceptable risk limits.
  • Collaborate with software and data engineers to build and scale automated, programmatic technical tools and analytics dashboards for portfolio and agreement evaluation.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical or quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science), or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in program management.
  • Experience in technical program management, bridging the gap between quantitative risk modeling, financial analysis, and software/data engineering.
  • Experience in the energy sector, with wholesale power markets, renewable energy transactions, or utility-scale portfolio management.
  • Experience of energy agreement structuring, energy risk management principles, and quantitative analysis.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 8 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
  • Expertise in major wholesale electricity markets (e.g., PJM, ERCOT, CAISO) and experience structuring complex transactions in multiple regions globally.
  • Proficiency in programming or query languages (e.g., Python, SQL, C++) to build, review, or scale advanced financial mathematics models, including option pricing, stochastic modeling, and Monte Carlo simulations.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Ads Platform
descriptionHtml:
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.
Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams.
  • Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching.
  • Develop the long-term technical goal and roadmap. Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs. Contribute strategically and technically to influence the agentic buying initiatives and solutions.
  • Oversee systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and review product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems.
  • Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices. Collaborate, advocate, architect and design agentic interfaces to meet the needs of first-party, second-party and third-party agentic solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 7 years of experience with full stack development, across the back-end such as Java, Python, GO, or C++ codebases, and front-end including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.
  • 5 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • 5 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
  • Experience in AI Platforms or Generative AI (GenAI) agents and large-scale distributed systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 5 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Experience in either of the following: Napa, Qubos, Spanner, F1, Resource Management.

title: Staff Hardware Engineer, TPU Interconnect and Packaging
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a Staff Hardware Engineer in the Interconnect and Packaging team, you will serve as a technical lead driving technology roadmaps for Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) interconnects and optical packaging. You will bridge hardware architecture with foundry manufacturing capability, leading cross-functional teams to deliver multi-terabit packaging capabilities.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Define the architectural strategy and package technology selection for next-generation TPU systems, incorporating 2.5D/3D interposers, embedded bridges, and co-packaged optics (CPO) modules.
  • Drive electro-optical co-design across silicon photonics dies, laser sources, package substrates, and drive electronics to maximize interconnect bandwidth density and energy efficiency.
  • Establish signal integrity, power delivery, thermal management, and mechanical design rules across multi-chiplet heterogeneous assemblies.
  • Partner with outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) vendors, foundries, and optical component suppliers to co-develop custom substrate processes, sub-micron alignment flows, and optical coupling interfaces.
  • Lead full-lifecycle technology qualification from pathfinding and architectural simulation through to mass production readiness, while mentoring engineers, fostering technical excellence, and driving engineering best practices across the organization.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Optical Engineering, Microelectronics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in semiconductor packaging, integration, or interconnect design.
  • Experience with interconnect modeling, 2.5D/3D interposer design rules, or chiplet package assembly.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Optical Science, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Technical expertise in silicon photonics integration, Co-Packaged Optics (CPO), 2.5D silicon interposers, and high-density substrate routing.
  • Deep knowledge of wafer-level packaging (WLP), chiplet interconnect standards, dynamic thermal control, and high-density power delivery networks.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering first-of-a-kind optical packaging or heterogeneous 3D integration solutions into production systems.
  • Track record of leading complex package development programs for high-performance computing (HPC) or AI accelerator platforms.

descriptionHtml:

You will work as a Research Scientist, serving as a technical expert responsible for evaluating and mitigating safety risks of frontier AI models (primarily but not limited to LLMs) in the biology domain; specifically, model assistance in the acquisition, development and dissemination of harmful biological agents and other dual use entities.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. descriptionHtml:

title: Senior IP/Sub System Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:

Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will own the full verification life-cycle from verification planning and test execution to coverage closure, with an emphasis on meeting stringent AI/ML performance and accuracy goals, build constrained-random verification environments capable of exposing corner-case bugs and ensuring the reliability of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) workloads on Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) hardware. Preferred qualifications:

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

title: External Affairs Manager, US Federal Affairs, Government Affairs and Public Policy
descriptionHtml:

You’ll combine creativity and intellectual excellence with the organizational skills to manage various campaigns, projects and initiatives. In this role, you’ll advocate for Google to bring external perspectives back into the company to inform our perception and direction.
