As a Government Affairs and Public Policy Manager on the US Federal External Affairs team, you will manage day-to-day engagement with a portfolio of external third-party organizations—including think tanks, civil society organizations, public interest groups, and advocacy coalitions.

Google takes its responsibilities seriously, including engaging with government and other stakeholders on important public policy challenges. The Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team leads the company’s engagement with executive branch officials, legislators, regulators and third-parties in the formation of public policy. Working closely with Google leaders, GAPP seeks to identify key policy issues, listen carefully to others’ views and opinions, and distill and share the company’s perspective on those issues with external stakeholders. While we focus on challenges affecting the internet, our issue areas are increasingly broad and encompass many areas where public policy, business, and technology intersect.

As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The FIA Execution Program Manager (Execution TPgM) is a critical governance and support role within the Field Integration Assembly (FIA) team. Tasked with overseeing the end-to-end (E2E) project lifecycle, this role focuses on empowering site teams to self-deliver while maintaining strict adherence to the FIA EMEA Strategy. The primary mission is to shift data center construction from a traditional stick-built process to a high-precision, manufacturing-led assembly model through the implementation of Field Assembly Plants (FAPs).

This role oversees project phases (BOD, IFC, Tender, and Construction) to ensure compliance, quality, and efficiency.

Operating within the Nordics region (Mega Scale), the Execution Program Manager serves as a governance lead to minimize administrative burdens on site teams, ensuring they can focus exclusively on generating megawatts through standardized, repeatable solutions.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Facilitate specialty contractor onboarding to the FIA prescriptive model while governing tender and delivery workflows against regional rates and technical specifications.
  • Monitor on-site installation processes to ensure strict adherence to programmatic scope, cost, and schedule baselines.
  • Review and approve Issued For Construction (IFC) models and Technical Submissions, conducting Basis of Design (BOD) deviation analyses to evaluate scope, schedule, and cost impacts.
  • Maintain the critical components inventory list, tracking off-site manufacturing milestones to proactively mitigate factory-to-site delivery risks.

  • Exceptional negotiation and communication skills to manage complex boundaries between regional site teams, design-assist vendors, and Tier 3 suppliers.

title: Staff Engineering Analyst Manager
descriptionHtml:
As a part of the Trust and Safety Cloud AI team, the vanguard of Cloud AI security and safety, your mission is to safeguard users, protect the integrity of our platforms, and ensure the responsible deployment of AI products at global scale. You will operate at the critical intersection of cutting-edge AI research and real-world security, building the foundational defenses that prevent the misuse of generative models and agents. You will pioneer proactive threat detection and robust mitigation strategies, empower Google Cloud to push the boundaries of AI innovation safely, ethically, and securely.

As a part of the Engineering Analyst Manager for Cloud AI Security and Abuse, you will lead a high-performing team protecting Google Cloud’s cutting-edge AI products and developer platforms (including Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise, AI Studio, and Cloud APIs) against sophisticated adversarial actors and emerging frontier risks. You will sit at the intersection of data science, security engineering, and threat intelligence, your team uncovers complex abuse patterns across billions of events, architects automated detection and enforcement pipelines, and builds next-generation guardrails for generative and agentic AI systems.

You will combine people leadership with deep technical and analytical acumen, mentoring Engineering Analysts, guiding the development of AI-driven defenses, and partnering closely with leaders across Cloud, DeepMind, Security, Product, and Policy. Your leadership will ensure that Google’s enterprise and developer AI deployments remain resilient against exploitation while balancing rigorous protection with a friction-less customer experience.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $188000 - $274000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Mentor and grow a high-performing team of Engineering Analysts to foster a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Define the strategic vision, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), and roadmaps for Cloud AI security, balancing urgent incident response with foundational, long-term defenses.
  • Drive the design and deployment of scaled detection systems, including ML, Large Language Model (LLMs), and heuristic frameworks to mitigate threats like prompt injection and abuse.
  • Advance proactive threat intelligence, adversarial benchmarking, and automated red-teaming to identify novel attack vectors in agentic AI.
  • Partner cross-functionally across Engineering, Research, and Legal to translate security insights into hardened architectures, while establishing rigorous measurement frameworks to ensure operational precision for enterprise AI requests.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 10 years of experience in Trust and Safety, cybersecurity, or fraud detection, including 3 years managing technical teams.
  • Experience designing machine learning classifiers, neural networks, and automated red-teaming/vulnerability pipelines.
  • Experience influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Research, and Legal to implement large-scale defense-in-depth protections.
  • Expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, and autonomous agent threat landscapes, including adversarial risks like jailbreaking and data exfiltration.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering, Caching SRE
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

In this role, you will architect resilient, automated production environments that meet stringent service level objectives. You will lead the team through some of Google's most pressing issues, including: scaling our architecture across the portfolio to accommodate exponentially growing demands for infrastructure capacity, supporting the growing business and compliance needs across different product areas, and adapting our operational models to support highly accelerated product development cycles.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

title: Producer, Studio Production, Advanced Agentic Coding
descriptionHtml:
As the Producer, Studio Production for Advanced Agentic Coding, you will help build and run the dedicated video production engine for Google Antigravity. You will manage our physical video studio in Mountain View and lead end-to-end video execution, including directing, filming, editing, and packaging high-impact visual stories that showcase our agentic software development platform to developers and the broader industry.

In this role, you will serve as both the creative craftsperson and operational anchor of our multimedia output. You will produce everything from tentpole product launch videos and educational walkthroughs to technical live streams, developer deep-dives, and social content. Antigravity moves at the edge of AI, so we work fast and iterate rapidly. We are looking for someone who loves the craft of physical and digital production: someone who takes pride in a calibrated, shoot-ready studio, thrives behind a camera, cuts fluidly in Adobe Premiere, and can seamlessly translate complex software and developer workflows into polished, brand-aligned video.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain the Mountain View video production studio. Keep the facility organized, calibrated, and shoot-ready for marketing, DevRel, and product partners; manage all equipment prep, digital camera operation, multi-point studio lighting, and audio capture.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure, Google Cloud Compute
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

title: Offensive Security Consultant, Mandiant
descriptionHtml:
Mandiant's offensive security consulting team is responsible for performing Red and Purple Team assessments of customer environments. We breach the customer networks to reveal flaws, test weaknesses, and to exercise defensive teams and capabilities. We take Mandiant's frontline incident response and intelligence knowledge and apply cutting edge techniques and tradecraft being used by threat actors in the wild.

The consultants are offensive security experts who specialize at executing all stages of the attack lifecycle, from initial compromise, privilege escalation, lateral movement, to achieving desired objectives. We adapt to customer technologies, from on-premises networks, to modern cloud architecture, to zero-trust and identity-centric environments, and everything in between.

In this role, you will work together to emulate ransomware, financial, espionage, and other threat actors, and you will aim to deliver the most realistic breach scenarios.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

Responsibilities

  • Perform Red and Purple Team assessments, including end-to-end adversarial emulation of cyber attacks against customer organisations, and other technical cyber assessments including external penetration, web application, mobile and wireless security testing.
  • Expand the team’s capabilities through tool creation, research on offensive techniques, incorporation of threat actor intelligence, internal presentations and knowledge share.
  • Develop comprehensive and accurate reports and presentations for both technical and executive audiences, and act as a trusted advisor to C-level, security leaders and other customer stakeholders.
  • Assist with scoping prospective engagements, leading teams for engagements from kickoff through remediation phase, as well as mentoring other staff.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in offensive security (e.g., red teaming functions including network, web application, mobile, cloud, social engineering, scripting, or tool development).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Certifications related to offensive security including OSCE, OSEP, OSEE, OSCP, CISSP, CISA or relevant SANS courses.
  • Experience in creating security tools and understanding of underlying programming languages (such as Python, C#, C/C++, Rust, Nim or similar).
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical details through reporting and presentations to both technical and executive audiences.

title: Senior UX Engineer, Search Ads

title: Quản lý Khách hàng Chiến lược, Ứng dụng và Trò chơi, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để phát triển trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn mang trong mình niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng gặt hái được nhiều thành công nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google lẫn khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu tham vọng nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý Khách hàng Chiến lược, bạn sẽ là một chuyên gia tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất, thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng cho khách hàng thuộc lĩnh vực Ứng dụng và Trò chơi. Bạn sẽ đóng vai trò là một cố vấn tăng trưởng, tận dụng các giải pháp sử dụng AI của Google để mang lại kết quả kinh doanh và cải thiện dấu ấn trên toàn cầu của khách hàng. Bạn sẽ tập trung vào việc phát triển và cải thiện các chiến lược toàn phễu để đáp ứng các Chỉ báo hiệu suất chính (KPI) của khách hàng, chẳng hạn như Lợi tức trên chi tiêu quảng cáo (ROAS) và Giá trị vòng đời của khách hàng (LTV).

Bạn sẽ thúc đẩy sự xuất sắc bằng cách chinh phục khách hàng nhờ những giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hóa hiệu quả các giải pháp quảng cáo của chúng tôi. Bạn sẽ không ngừng chứng minh giá trị và làm nổi bật những thành công đã đạt được nhằm khơi dậy đà tăng trưởng trong tương lai cho khách hàng giữa kỷ nguyên AI đang không ngừng biến đổi.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi lớn trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách cung cấp trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google ở mức giá cạnh tranh trên Google Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường, và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên của khối LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh những công nghệ tiên tiến nhất, làm việc với các quản lý cấp cao, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả thực tế, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Trở thành chuyên gia sản phẩm, hợp tác với các giám đốc sản phẩm tại các công ty thuộc ngành Trò chơi để điều chỉnh mức chi tiêu tiếp thị cho phù hợp với mục tiêu kinh doanh.
  • Quản lý hiệu suất chiến dịch và phân bổ ngân sách trên bộ sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google (Ứng dụng, Tìm kiếm, Hiển thị, Video), liên tục cải thiện mức chi tiêu để gia tăng Lợi tức đầu tư (ROI).
  • Tiến hành phân tích hiệu suất (ví dụ: phân bổ, thử nghiệm chiến lược, phân khúc đối tượng) để khám phá thông tin chi tiết và giải quyết các thách thức của khách hàng.
  • Phân tích các tập dữ liệu để xác định những điểm tắc nghẽn về hiệu suất, đồng thời đề xuất các chiến lược giá thầu và khung đo lường (ví dụ: SKAdNetwork, GA4).
  • Cung cấp thông tin và vận động sự ủng hộ cho Google khi trình bày các sản phẩm mới, hiệu suất và kết quả của chiến dịch cho khách hàng và công ty quảng cáo.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm tập trung vào tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất, tối ưu hoá truyền thông hoặc chiến lược tiếp thị dựa trên dữ liệu.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để giao tiếp với các bên liên quan nội bộ và hỗ trợ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm sử dụng các công cụ phân tích (ví dụ: Google Analytics 4, mô hình phân bổ tiếp thị, trang tổng quan trực quan hoá dữ liệu và phần mềm bảng tính) cùng với kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.
  • Kiến thức về các sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google trên Ứng dụng, Video, Mạng Hiển thị và Tìm kiếm.
  • Hiểu biết về hệ sinh thái ứng dụng, bao gồm cả hoạt động tạo doanh thu và thu nạp người dùng dành riêng cho ngành Ứng dụng và trò chơi.
  • Khả năng gây ảnh hưởng đến các bên liên quan cả trong và ngoài tổ chức để đạt được mục tiêu.

title: App Solution Expert, gTech Ad Solutions (German, English)
descriptionHtml:

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google operates global fleets of custom AI accelerators (TPUs), general-purpose compute, networking, and data center power to run Gemini, Search, Google Cloud, Workspace, YouTube, and Ads. Our team builds the automated provisioning, resource management, and telemetry software that turns this physical footprint into live production capacity, closing the loop from planning to production so Google can scale its infrastructure efficiently and support reliable product growth.

If you are fundamentally motivated by resource efficiency, recognize the opportunity in front of Google in the AI landscape, and enjoy working across system and organizational boundaries to solve infrastructure problems at fleet scale, you should join us.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and evolution of software platforms for fleet resource management, usage telemetry, and closed-loop capacity automation.
  • Design and build scalable backend services, APIs, and data pipelines (in C++, Go, Python, Java, or SQL) that connect capacity planning workflows with production provisioning and reconciliation.
  • Develop algorithms and automated workflows to allocate capacity efficiently and coordinate balanced compute, AI accelerator, memory, storage, networking, and power resources across large-scale clusters.
  • Partner across product, model serving, cluster infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and capacity planning teams to integrate systems and deliver end-to-end fleet outcomes.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and help shape technical direction across ambiguous, multi-team infrastructure initiatives.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (such as C++, Go, Python, or Java), or 5 years of experience with an advanced degree.
  • 5 years of experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage, or hardware architecture.
  • 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
  • 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Distributed Systems, Operations Research, or a related technical field.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • Experience with capacity management, cluster scheduling, resource allocation, or automated provisioning systems.
  • Experience building high-reliability backend services, data platforms, and telemetry pipelines for large-scale production infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with ML serving or training infrastructure, hardware accelerators, or multi-resource optimization.
  • Ability to simplify and automate complex workflows and collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries.

title: Incident Response Consultant, Mandiant
descriptionHtml:
As an Incident Response Consultant, you will provide industry-leading incident response, assessment, transformation, managed detection and response, and training services with in-depth tactical support. You will work on engagements including assisting clients in navigating technically complex and high-profile incidents, performing forensic analysis, threat hunting, and malware triage.Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with internal and customer teams to investigate and contain incidents.
  • Lead and contribute to complex client-facing investigations and examine cloud, endpoint, and network-based sources of evidence.
  • Recognize and codify attacker Tools, Tactics, and Procedures (TTPs) and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs).
  • Develop and present comprehensive and accurate reports and presentations for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Build scripts, tools, or methodologies to enhance Mandiant’s incident investigation processes that can be applied to current and future investigations.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity a related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience working end-to-end incident response investigations, analysis, or containment actions.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Staff Software Engineer, ML Performance, GPU
descriptionHtml:

Our team’s focus on performance analysis and optimization identifies opportunities in Google production and research ML workloads and lands optimizations to entire fleet. We evaluate current and future ML workloads and runs performance/total cost of ownership simulations to collect roofline estimates and guide decision-making for the hardware teams.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

title: YouTube Partner Suite Experience Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Strategic Planning and Business Operations team is responsible for ensuring our teams are responsibly resourced to execute against YouTube’s most important priorities, enabling our executive team to lead their organizations effectively, and driving key cross-business initiatives globally.

As the Experience Manager for YouTube’s Partner Suite in San Bruno, you will work closely with our Partnerships teams to operationalize our space reserved for meetings among YouTube leadership, top creators and artists, and senior partner executives.

You will approach with a partner-centric perspective to ensure the on-site operations are exceptional through establishing and overseeing reservation protocols and prioritizing inbound requests, partnering with on-site teams (e.g., catering, facilities, tech support, security) to ensure the space is always partner-ready, and remaining agile and responsive to last minute changes and adjustments.

Your broad understanding of YouTube’s business and partnership priorities, and your ability to identify creative solutions and influence without authority will help land these critical creator and partner moments. You are comfortable with ambiguity and you effortlessly adapt your approach to reconcile with changing priorities, direction, and guidance.

You are comfortable working cross-functionally in a results-driven environment, have a proven track record of managing competing priorities, and want to be part of an innovative global team forging new ground in the world of technology and entertainment.

Note: This role is required to be in-person in our San Bruno office up to five days a week, depending on partner meeting schedules.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $152000 - $221000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the creator and partner experience and oversee daily operations, including reservations, escalations, operational support (e.g., catering, tech, facilities, security), access rights, budget support, etc.
  • Own ‘air-traffic control’ for the YouTube Partner Suite, including reviewing and approving all engagements hosted in the space and being mindful of concurrent or conflicting usage.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for questions about meeting rooms, parking, and other logistics; approach internal and external communications with a sense of hospitality, responsiveness, and professionalism.
  • Develop and socialize operating procedures and guidelines for using the space; gather feedback from users and stakeholders and drive continuous improvement as needed.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience within one or more of the following fields: program management, executive administration, management consulting, business operations, or corporate strategy

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience delivering exceptional service and creating positive, lasting experiences for creators, artists, and key external partners.
  • Experience operating an event venue, conference facility, or executive meeting center within a large organization.
  • Experience with process design and continuous improvement, including establishing operational protocols from scratch and refining workflows over time.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and adapt effectively to unexpected operational challenges while ensuring seamless execution.
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships, engage stakeholders, and drive alignment across teams without formal authority.
  • Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, including developing clear messaging and operational guidance for various partner audiences.

title: Test Engineer, WiFi Test Lead
locations: New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
descriptionHtml:
At Google, our philosophy is build it, break it and then rebuild it better. That thinking is at the core of how we approach testing at Google. Unlike roles with similar names at the other companies, Test Engineers at Google aren't manual testers -- you write scripts to automate testing and create tools so developers can test their own code. As a Test Engineer, you navigate Google's massive codebase, identify weak spots and constantly design better and creative ways to break software and identify potential problems. You'll have a huge impact on the quality of Google's growing suite of products and services.

As a part of the team, you will play a key role in delivering Pixel phones with exceptional Software/Hardware integrated quality. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in multiple sites internationally, with a scope of End-to-End power and thermal testing. You will strive for quality and effective end-to-end automation testing as the team's scope is system testing across Pixel platforms with focus on power performance, power up and down the stack from apps, Android OS, multiple SW and subsystems features, modem and other connectivity modules that power the hardware.

The Google Pixel team focuses on designing and delivering the world's most helpful mobile experience. The team works on shaping the future of Pixel devices and services through some of the most advanced designs, techniques, products, and experiences in consumer electronics. This includes bringing together the best of Google’s artificial intelligence, software, and hardware to build global smartphones and create transformative experiences for users across the world.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, build, and execute end-to-end functional test cases covering IEEE 802.11 MAC/PHY protocol features, association/authentication state machines, WPA2/WPA3 security protocols, and 802.11k/v/r fast roaming.
  • Perform rigorous throughput, latency, rate-vs-range, rate-vs-orientation, coexistence/interoperability testing in both conductive and Over-The-Air RF environments, and design, build, and maintain automated test suites and frameworks using Python, integration with CI/CD pipelines, and automated test bed orchestration.
  • Utilize packet capture tools (Wireshark, Omnipeek) and RF protocol analyzers to debug frame-level issues, channel access bottlenecks, beamforming behavior, and connection drops.
  • Maintain and calibrate state-of-the-art wireless test setups, including RF attenuation chambers, shielded enclosures, programmable attenuators, channel emulators, and traffic generation tools (e.g., IxChariot, Spirent, OctoScope, Iperf).
  • Partner with firmware, software, hardware teams to isolate root causes, track defects, provide actionable debug logs, and verify bug fixes.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in Wi-Fi functional and performance testing.
  • Experience with IEEE 802.11 standards (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be) and protocols, including MAC/PHY interaction, frame structures, MIMO/MU-MIMO, OFDMA, channel bonding, and mesh networking architectures.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 years of experience providing technical leadership and leading projects (e.g., test, release, etc.).
  • 1 year of experience working with executive leaders.
  • Experience with analytical and debugging skills with the ability to summarize complex technical findings clearly for engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience with packet sniffers (Wireshark, Omnipeek, Sanjole), wireless traffic generators (IxChariot, Spirent, OctoScope), and RF test equipment (spectrum analyzers, power meters).
  • Understanding of TCP/IP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, and routing/switching concepts.

title: Research Engineer, Bioresilience, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
At Google, research-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers.

As a Research Engineer joining the Bioresilience Initiative (https://deepmind.google/blog/our-approach-to-bioresilience/) within the DeepMind Impact Accelerator team. You will build and deploy novel applications leveraging Google’s frontier AI and generative models.

As a part of the team, you will accelerate DeepMind’s societal impact on critical global challenges, collaborate with Biosecurity, GenAI, and Alphabet partners like Google Research, Cloud, and Isomorphic Labs, will develop solutions across biological threat prevention, early pathogen detection, and rapid response. You will translate cutting-edge AI breakthroughs into scalable tools that protect communities worldwide.

Your position requires domain expertise in life sciences, computational biology, or biosecurity alongside solid software engineering skills to prototype, benchmark, and scale products using state-of-the-art GenAI tools.

Join DeepMind to advance AI development, protect society from biological threats, and accelerate high-quality product innovation for public benefit.Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer varied learning opportunities and career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product leadership, external authorities (biosecurity organizations, institutes, public health bodies), and cross-functional teams to navigate ambiguity, understand real-world biodefense challenges, and define technical architectures across Bioresilience workstreams.
  • Curate specialized biological datasets, design rigorous domain evaluations, and execute fine-tuning to maximize model performance on complex biological tasks.
  • Engineer 0-to-1 solutions and workflows using internal platforms, building sophisticated agents powered by foundation models such as Gemini, AlphaFold, and AlphaGenome.
  • Synthesize partner insights, edge cases, and deployment signals to inform future frontier model development and biological safety guardrails.
  • Advocate safe GenAI deployment best practices in bioresilience, demonstrating peak frontier model capabilities to solve critical biological problems end-to-end.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
  • 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience applying deep learning models to biological data (such as functional genomics or protein sequence data).
  • Experience manipulating common life science data types including FASTQ, SAM/BAM, gff, BED, VCF, and PDB/CIF using bioinformatics or health informatics tools.
  • Knowledge of life sciences, computational biology, or biosecurity (e.g., molecular biology, pathogen genomics, computational plant pathology, protein engineering, bioinformatics, or metagenomics).
  • Ability to identify, break down, and solve ambiguous and complex process and technical problems that span across many teams and organizations.
  • Ability to translate biological concepts into computational workflows and evaluation benchmarks.

title: Head of Semiconductor Manufacturing Planning and Fulfillment
locations: New Taipei, Banqiao District, New Taipei City, Taiwan
Zhubei, Zhubei City, Hsinchu County, Taiwan
descriptionHtml:
The Google Custom Silicon Operations team is responsible for all external manufacturing engagement and supplier management for the foundry and outsource manufacturing (OSAT) partners for building custom silicon for Google consumer hardware products. This includes foundry/OSAT sourcing, supplier management, end-to-end planning and procurement, and execution of development and manufacturing operations, with our suppliers in partnership with Google Engineering. It includes strategy development and orchestration with key stakeholders to shape the supply ecosystem for better partnership, capacity flexibility, high quality, business continuity, and cost effectiveness. It also includes on time delivery of ASIC (Application Specific Integrated Circuits) and other companion chips.


The Head of Semiconductor Manufacturing Planning and Fulfillment leads end-to-end supply chain operations for custom silicon and companion chips within Google’s hardware ecosystem. This role is responsible for establishing execution frameworks for supply and demand planning, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring material readiness from NPI through mass production. Key priorities include optimizing inventory visibility, logistics, and financial reconciliation, while driving fulfillment execution (PO management, production control). Additionally, you will report supply risks to executive stakeholders and build high-performing teams, fostering a culture of accountability and effective cross-functional collaboration. The ideal applicant will possess deep expertise in supply chain planning, semiconductor sub-component manufacturing processes or manufacturing operations management, coupled with strong problem-solving skills, and a proven track record in managing complex supply chains in a changing environment.

Responsibilities

  • Establish supply-demand execution frameworks and orchestration protocols for custom silicon, integrating signals from SOCs, memory, and manufacturing constraints to drive decision-making.
  • Orchestrate material readiness across global suppliers and internal stakeholders for new product introduction (NPI) and mass production, providing scenario plans and informed recommendations to achieve product launch milestones.
  • Optimize end-to-end inventory visibility and logistical flows from foundry to finished goods, partnering with Logistics, Finance, and Engineering to ensure regulatory compliance, complex yield reconciliation, and cycle-time efficiency.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfillment and production control—including POs, payments, and hot lot tracking—while reporting supply risks through dashboards; maintain data integrity and a single source of truth for all deliverables.
  • Cultivate a high-performing team by leading end-to-end talent management—from recruitment to mentorship—while fostering an accountable culture and resolving conflicts to ensure seamless supply operations.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in program or project management.
  • 10 years of experience in semiconductor planning and fulfillment, and experience with mobile SoC development flows and manufacturing processes for Foundry, Die Prep, Assembly, and Test.
  • 7 years of experience in a leadership role.
  • Experience developing and deploying supply/demand planning and fulfillment systems, processes, and execution logistics, and leading initiatives in organizational development and cross-functional collaboration.

Preferred qualifications:

  • In-depth familiarity with Mobile SoC development flows and manufacturing processes for Foundry, Die Prep, Assembly, and Test.
  • Deep knowledge of foundry and OSAT suppliers and ecosystem with a specific focus on high-volume Mobile SoCs or complex consumer product applications.
  • Proven ability to unite teams toward common goals and resolve conflict in a matrixed global organization.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical engineering teams (Silicon/Hardware) and business operations.
  • Executive presence in managing suppliers, with excellent communication and presentation skills to key stakeholders and executive audience.

title: Technical Program Manager III, NPI Programs, Technical Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you will lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You will plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. title: Software Engineer, Finance and Growth Platform, Payments
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Consumer Payments Finance and Growth Platform team owns the infrastructure powering payments data processing, growth, engagement, and business generation across Google’s Consumer Payments global business. We provide reliable, high-performance, and scalable solutions for users to have rich financial search and insights, reach users via notifications, emails, in-surface communications, and offer rewards and incentives.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. title: Edge-AI Verification Lead, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will work to shape the future of an edge-AI product, bringing high-performance intelligence to the edge. You will have an opportunity to drive distributed inference technology that powers real-time systems where latency and reliability are mission-critical.

You will be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing autonomous solutions that define the next generation of intelligent infrastructure and hardware for the edge. You will contribute to the innovation behind products that transform industries, leveraging your expertise in system-level integration and localized processing to deploy complex AI models across sophisticated hardware platforms, ensuring intelligence is embedded exactly where the action happens.Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the verification of an edge AI IP, to be used in Google edge-AI products.
  • Lead a team of chip verification engineers. Plan tasks, allocate people, hold verification design/code reviews, and drive verification execution.

title: Creator Partnerships Associate (Fixed-Term Contract)

title: Electrical Manufacturing Engineer, Platforms Infrastructure Engineering
descriptionHtml:

Our Platforms Infrastructure Engineering team designs and builds the
hardware and software technologies that power all of Google's services. Our computational challenges are complex and unique, enabled by cutting-edge custom hardware designed and made in-house. Your work has the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our cutting-edge data centers, affecting millions of Google users.

title: Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to users' needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design.

SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

To learn more: check out our books on Site Reliability Engineering or read a career profile about why a Software Engineer chose to join SRE.

In this role, you will build and manage foundational layers to ensure developer solutions and AI agent platforms are reliable, secure, and efficient. You’ll partner with engineering teams to support workflows across hybrid environments, including Google Cloud and on-premises infrastructure. You will also develop automation and service management frameworks to enhance developer productivity and system reliability. In-person interviews are required.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of Software/Systems Engineers on projects for users and be directly responsible for uptime.
  • Oversee end-to-end availability and performance of key services and build automation to prevent problem recurrence, automate response to all non-exceptional service conditions.
  • Lead by example, mentor the team and establish credibility through quality technical execution.
  • Manage on-call rotations across continents, using a follow-the-sun model.
  • Design, write and deliver software to improve the availability, scalability, latency and efficiency of Google's services.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
  • 3 years of experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems.
  • 3 years of experience managing people or teams.
  • 3 years of experience leading projects.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Senior DFT Design Engineer, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. As a Senior DFT Design Engineer, you will define, design, analyze the DFT implementation and flow, that supports the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Develop DFT strategy and architecture (e.g., hierarchical DFT, DFT for high speed iOS, Analog DFT).

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience in IP integration (e.g., memories, test controllers, Test Access Point (TAP), and DFT for multi die SoCs).
  • Experience in SoC cycles, silicon bringup, and silicon debug activities.
  • Experience in fault modeling.

title: Principal Engineer, Agent Harness and Capabilities, GeminiApp, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
As a Principal/Distinguished Engineer IC within GeminiApp, you will serve as the technical anchor bridging Agentic Harness Infrastructure and Quality & Foundational Capabilities. As we unify Gemini Chat and Tasks onto a single agentic runtime powering everything from fast informational queries to complex, long-running multi-step workflows and sub-agents, your mission is to push our harness to the next frontier of reliability and intelligence.

Your primary focus is architecting and building a self-healing, self-improving agentic harness—leaning into frontier models to drive automated, closed-loop improvement across the stack. You will design both fast runtime loops (mining production signals and failure trajectories to automatically refine skills, prompts, tool usage, and routing) and slow training loops (curating and distilling high-signal multi-turn trajectories back into GDM GenAI post-training). Beyond the obvious roadmap, you will identify unorganized technical opportunities across evaluation, trajectory quality, and harness architecture—spending ~70-80% of your time in code and prototypes on high-leverage problems and ~20-30% driving cross-organizational technical strategy and mentorship.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Trust and Safety, Anti-Abuse, Google Search
descriptionHtml:

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

Maintaining user trust requires protecting Search from increasingly sophisticated adversarial threats. The proliferation of Generative AI, automated synthetic content networks, LLM-driven parasite SEO, and agentic scraping has fundamentally transformed web spam from simple keyword manipulation into complex, automated adversarial campaigns.

As a Senior Product Manager for Google Search Anti-Spam and Abuse, you will define and drive the multi-year product strategy, technical architecture, and algorithmic defense mechanisms to combat AI-driven abuse at a global scale. You will partner closely with Research Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Regulatory and Policy Experts, Anti-Abuse experts, and Operations teams to ensure Search delivers high-quality, authentic information.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

  • Build and own Go-To-Market (GTM) and comprehensive proactive/reactive communication plans for defense rollouts and policy updates.

title: Staff SRE Software Engineer, Google Home
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Home SRE engineers the reliability, performance, and scalability behind Google Home, powering ambient experiences across more than 100 million connected devices worldwide. Google Home is in the midst of rapid product evolution and high momentum, driven by major software breakthroughs like Gemini for Home alongside a continuous pipeline of recent and upcoming hardware launches.

Our team operates at the unique intersection of physical hardware, distributed cloud infrastructure, and next-generation real-time Voice AI. We focus on high-leverage architectural engagements—partnering closely with development teams to simplify core backends, optimize ML serving, and ensure smart home interactions are instant, reliable, and trustworthy.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end hardware development of advanced Reference Validation Platforms, silicon characterization boards, and high-density test fixtures.

You will manage bleeding-edge electrical, thermal, and mechanical tests—from designing high-current multi-phase power delivery networks to routing multi-gigabit high-speed serial links across ultra-high-layer-count substrates.

The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.

Responsibilities

  • Define system specifications, block diagrams, power trees, clock distribution topologies, and component selection for server-class silicon validation platforms and characterization fixtures.
  • Drive schematic capture and guided physical layout for high-density interconnect, ultra-high-layer-count (24+ layers) printed circuit boards utilizing advanced dielectric materials using Cadence Allegro, Concept, and OrCAD.
  • Partner with Signal Integrity and Power Integrity teams to implement decoupling strategies, multi-phase voltage regulator module designs capable of delivering high-current rails (>500 amperes to 1000+ amperes), and impedance-controlled high-speed routing.
  • Direct post-silicon board bring-up in the laboratory using high-speed oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and thermal imaging; mentored team members and established organization-wide hardware design guidelines.
  • Enforce strict Design for Manufacturing, Design for Assembly, and Design for Test guidelines; partnered with printed circuit board fabricators and electronics manufacturing service assembly houses to resolve technical issues and optimize yield.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 10 years of experience in high-speed, multi-layer board-level hardware design.
  • 5 years of experience managing teams.
  • Experience designing and routing high-speed digital interfaces (e.g., PCIe Gen6, DDR5/LPDDR6, USB4, I3C, SPI, high-speed SerDes) and clock distribution networks.
  • Experience in schematic capture and PCB layout tools (specifically Cadence Allegro Design Authoring/Concept HDL and Allegro PCB Editor).
  • Experience designing multi-phase point-of-load (PoL) voltage regulators, high-efficiency DC-DC converters, power sequencing, and high-transient power delivery systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with a focus on Hardware Systems, Power Electronics, or High-Speed Circuit Design.
  • 12 years of experience designing Reference Validation Platforms (RVPs), ATE characterization boards, or server motherboards for enterprise CPUs or AI/ML accelerators (TPUs/GPUs).
  • Experience designing ultra-high-current power delivery networks (>1000A) with advanced digital multi-phase PWM controllers (PMBus/AVS).
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering projects, driving ODM/EMS vendors, and mentoring junior/mid-level hardware engineers.
  • Deep knowledge of HDI, micro-vias, rigid-flex, low-loss laminate selection, and advanced manufacturing capabilities at PCB fabrication vendors.

As part of this team you fully immerse yourself in data collection, draw insight from analysis, and then zoom out to develop compelling, synthesized recommendations. Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations.

title: Regional Lead Data Center Electrical Engineer, Google Data Centers

Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department -- cutting-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements -- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.

With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical).

As a Lead Electrical Engineer (EE) in Data Center Services (DCS) team, you will drive consistency in technical planning/execution across North America. You will represent DCS in various programmatic initiatives where a construction execution lens is required. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. title: Technical Program Manager, Trust and Safety Workspace Smart Review
descriptionHtml:

title: Site Reliability Manager, AlphaNet Core SRE
descriptionHtml:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. We operate Google's SDN enabled campus aggregation and WAN production networks and drive its transformation to achieve industry defining levels of reliability, efficiency and scalability to meet ever-evolving customer needs.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Canada: $216000 - $221000 (CAD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead designs of major software components, systems, and features to improve the availability, scalability, latency, and efficiency of Google's services.
  • Lead sustainable incident response, blameless postmortems, and production improvements that result in direct business opportunities for Google.
  • Provide guidance to other team members on managing availability and performance of mission critical services, building automation to prevent problem recurrence, and building automated responses for non-exceptional service conditions.
  • Mentor and train other team members on design techniques and coding standards, and to cultivate innovation and collaboration across multiple teams.
  • Manage individual projects priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience with programming in one or more programmng languages: Go, Python, C++.
  • 4 years of experience leading projects.
  • 3 years of experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems, and working with administration (e.g. filesystems, inodes, system calls) or networking (e.g. TCP/IP, routing, network topologies and hardware, SDN).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

title: Principal, Strategic Partnerships Lead, Modular Data Center Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
The Modular Manufacturing and Integration team is pioneering a paradigm shift in how Google builds and scales technical infrastructure for the AI era. Shifting away from conventional, on-site, purpose-built civil construction, our mission is to industrialize data center delivery through mass manufacturing, off-site integration, and standardized modular building blocks.

By pushing system complexity upstream into factory environments, we enable rapid "square wave" capacity deployment—bringing AI compute, power, cooling, and network fabric online with speed. Operating at the intersection of AI Systems and Infrastructure (AI2), Google Data Centers (GDC), Systems and Manufacturing (ISM), and Google Global Infrastructure (GGI), our organization designs the modular product platform and executes the commercial, operational, and delivery strategies required to land technical infrastructure at gigawatt scale.

As a Principal, Strategic Partnership Leader, you will serve as the lead commercial architect and premier agreement-maker responsible for building the global industrial manufacturing ecosystem that underpins Google’s modular data center strategy. Operating in a high-growth, highly ambiguous space. You will design, originate, and execute commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.

In this individual contributor role, you will lead high-stakes negotiations with C-suite executives across global industrial manufacturers, modular fabricators, and engineering integrators. Your focus will be developing business partnerships to enable this strategic capability for Google. You will operate with executive autonomy, mobilizing and leading cross-functional agreement teams across Engineering, Hardware Supply Chain, Finance, and Legal to turn technical modular designs into legally binding, commercially sound global agreements.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Responsibilities

  • Create commercial structures tailored to modular manufacturing.
  • Lead global market analyses to evaluate supplier capabilities, manufacturing throughput, cost dynamics, and regional industrial readiness across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Act as Google’s primary commercial negotiator in high-stakes discussions with C-suite leaders (e.g., CEOs, CFOs, COOs) of major global industrial and manufacturing companies.
  • Assemble and direct agreement teams comprising Technical Leads, Commodity Managers, Legal Counsel, and Corporate Finance to drive transaction milestones from origination through board approval and signature.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics, Law, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 15 years of experience originating, structuring, and closing multi-year commercial transactions or industrial alliances.
  • 15 years of experience leading direct, face-to-face commercial negotiations with executive-level (i.e., C-suite/VP) external and internal stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Ability to navigate ambiguous, greenfield commercial spaces, constructing novel contractual mechanisms from scratch.
  • Financial fluency in capital allocation, capacity reservation economics, total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling, and incentive-aligned pricing structures.

title: Senior UX Researcher, YouTube
descriptionHtml:

In this role, you’ll use your methodological skills to address the high-stakes problems that only a specialist can solve - while using new tools and adjacent skills to move up the value chain and make change happen.

We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

title: Web Solutions Engineer, YouTube
descriptionHtml:
As part of YouTube Technology and Insights, our team builds the systems that make sure YouTube accurately pays its enterprise music, TV, and streaming-device partners, turning signed contracts into structured terms and reliable payments. Our direction is to deliver exceptional technology that empowers YouTube to secure and execute high value agreements.

To achieve our goal, we are leveraging AI to extract contract terms and automate agreement implementation. We are also building AI agents that support YouTube business across the agreement lifecycle, from analysis to negotiation to execution.

Join us to build AI-driven, consumer-grade tools for the people who negotiate and run YouTube's biggest agreements.

Google's Web Solutions Engineers build software solutions for complex business problems. descriptionHtml:

Designed for multi-task learning across various surfaces, these models are applied to numerous downstream tasks, including retrieval, user action prediction, rich user generation, and knowledge distillation for training more compact models.

Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.
